rules: Fields both scorers agree on are adopted unchanged.

Edges: margin when, at normal viewing size, unpainted paper reads as a band, a fade to white, or a corner the wash visibly stops short of; pale painted sky or wall and paper flecks visible only on zoom are not margins.
Lettering: glyphs on halos, titles, scrolls or hulls and corner scribbles count, conservatively, even when the plan asks for writing.
noFormFigure no/na disputes resolve to no; neither is a figure.
